source: NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (psi.nasa.gov): each id, DOI and count read from the investigation metadata and summary tables downloaded on 14 Nov 2026 into datasets/psi/.

items.name: Saffire-III
items.measured: Two SIBAL fabric samples burned at 30 cm/s (concurrent and opposed flow); flight telemetry: radiometers, anemometers, pressure, and the Cygnus cabin smoke detector (obscuration and scatter)
items.rows: 2 samples in the summary table; 11,450-row flight telemetry file

items.name: Saffire-II
items.measured: Nine samples (silicone, SIBAL fabric, PMMA, Nomex) burned in a 20 cm/s flow duct; burn times and spread rates in the summary table

items.name: Saffire-I
items.measured: Two large SIBAL fabric samples (40.6 x 94 cm) burned at 20 cm/s, concurrent and opposed flow

items.name: BASS-II
items.facility: Microgravity Science Glovebox, SPICE flow duct
items.measured: Flame spread and extinction over PMMA rods and sheets and SIBAL fabric versus airflow and oxygen; the summary table holds test conditions, not spread rates

items.name: BASS
items.facility: Microgravity Science Glovebox, SPICE flow duct
items.measured: Burning and suppression of solid samples; burn outcomes and crew notes

items.name: SAME
items.measured: Smoke particle size from overheated spacecraft materials

items.name: SAME-R
items.measured: Reflight of SAME: Kapton, silicone, lampwick, Teflon and Pyrell heated in 0 to 8.1 cm/s flow, smoke aged up to 1,923 s; the table holds conditions, not particle sizes

items.name: DAFT / DAFT-2
items.measured: Test dust (Arizona Road Dust) counted by a modified P-Trak and a DustTrak in the ISS cabin, to check the counter SAME relied on works in microgravity

items.name: FLEX
items.measured: Methanol and heptane droplets: extinction and burning rate versus O2, CO2, He, N2, pressure and droplet size

items.name: FLEX-2
items.measured: Follow-on droplet tests; condition ranges only in the summary table

items.name: Cool Flames Investigation (droplets)
items.measured: Low-temperature 'cool flames' that persist after the visible flame goes out

items.name: SPICE
items.facility: Microgravity Science Glovebox, SPICE flow duct
items.measured: Smoke point: flame length at which a gas flame starts to emit soot, versus fuel, burner size and co-flow

items.name: SLICE
items.facility: Microgravity Science Glovebox, SPICE flow duct
items.measured: Lifted and attached gas-jet flames in co-flow

items.name: ACME E-FIELD Flames
items.measured: Gas flames under an applied electric field (electric-field effects on laminar diffusion flames)

items.name: ACME CFI-G
items.measured: Cool flames with gaseous fuels; oxygen up to 85% in inverse flames

items.name: ACME Flame Design
items.measured: Normal and inverse ethylene and propane flames, studied for soot-free flame design

items.name: ACME BRE
items.measured: Burning Rate Emulator: gas burner that mimics the flammability of condensed fuels
